title: Characterising the nature and effect of sensory overload in an undergraduate chemistry teaching laboratory
content:
Chem. Educ. Res. Pract., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5RP00305A, Paper
Sally Stone, Benjamin E. Arenas
Sensory overload occurs when an individual's sensory inputs exceed their processing capacity; the inability of a person to process sensory stimuli can affect their state of mind, emotions, and behaviours....
